text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I had thought the road to glory blocked and impassable…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But that is when I saw my prayers answered one by one, clearing the blockage away!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thanks to my fans who never gave up on me, we've come to the last big event of the spring season—the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And I won't let it all be for naught, Trainer! I'll run the best race of my life!
choice_data_list: How are you feeling? You ready?
How are you feeling? You ready?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I am. I used to compete by scraping by on my good luck. I chose to only follow my predictions…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But now I've got the hopes of all my fans to count on! I feel stronger than ever!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: My wish to win, and my fans' wish to see me win…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Add a little dollop of luck on top of that, and there isn't a single thing to be scared of.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Fate will not win this race for me—victory will be claimed by me, and me alone!
choice_data_list: …Maybe you should reel it in just a little?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, I was honestly thinking the same…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But my passion is real! I'm going to rebuild myself and deliver a result worth celebrating.
